messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — onboarded reranker-v4 (FP16 -> int8 PTQ) and seeing a weird signal: NDCG stable but top-1 MRR drops ~6% on the long-query slices. anyone seen something like this?
anya: hmm, that's a big top-1 swing. Is it across datasets or one holdout? :thinking_face: 
sam: Looks most pronounced on docs with lots of code blocks / preformatted text. baseline (fp16) fine. int8 only.
maria: could be tokenization / padding differences for long contexts. Did the quant build change tokenizer preprocessing?
dylan: not intentionally. I pushed the int8 runtime kernels only. But we did change the default prompt priming (we add a 3-token prefix for safety).
anya: prefix could shift top-1 if it nudges token alignment for short candidates inside long docs. can you repro offline with and without prefix?
sam: yes — quick run: `python eval.py --model reranker-v4-int8 --slice long-codeblocks --no-prefix` vs `--prefix '<CTX>'` shows the gap disappears without prefix.
maria: interesting. so runtime adds prefix by default but the fp16 backend didn't. that's an onboarding mismatch.
dylan: oh yikes, I thought prefixing was gated. I'll check runtime flags. if true, we shouldn't change serve-time prep without updating eval harness.
anya: can we patch two things: 1) add an explicit flag in the eval harness to mirror runtime prefixing; 2) run a quick ablation on candidate truncation (end vs middle) since code blocks alter token importance.
sam: +1. I ran candidate truncation ablation (end-truncate vs doc-snippet) and top-1 varied a lot — code blocks near head preserved helps.
maria: operational fix: make default runtime prefix opt-in for new models until eval harness mirrors it. Also add a regression alert for top-1 MRR on the long-codeblocks slice.
dylan: I'll open a small PR to revert the default prefix and add a runtime flag.
anya: I'll update the eval config: add `runtime_prefix: <optional>` and a canned ablation job: `slice=long-codeblocks; truncation=[end, middle]; prefix=[on,off]`.
eval-bot: scheduled: rerank-ablation/1769532100 started (queue 2). link: https://ci.redwood/re-rank/1769532100
sam: thanks. action items: dylan PR to runtime, anya update eval harness, maria add alert rule. I'll collect the ablation CSV and post results here when done. :thumbsup:
